name: ill_conditioned_3x3
description: Mildly ill-conditioned 3x3 SDP: max x_11+epsilon*x_22 s.t. x_11=1, x_22=1, 2*x_12=0, X 3x3 PSD, where epsilon=1e-6. The small coefficient epsilon=1/1000000 creates mild ill-conditioning in the Schur complement. Optimal value = 1+1/1000000 = 1000001/1000000 (exact rational).
reference_method: Exact closed form: opt = 1 + 10^(-6) = 1000001/1000000 (exact rational arithmetic in Mathematica).
